findings.note: Covers lists trends that lean Over: the Over is 4-0-1 in Florida's last 5 games and 5-0 in its last 5 against Atlantic teams. The same page lists the Panthers total at U5.5 (-105), so other books may have a lower total than 6.5.

NHL.com projects Swayman and Markstrom to start in goal. Florida will be without Barkov, Marchand, Lundell (day to day) and Vilmanis, and Boston will be without Hagens and Poitras. Florida played Saturday, so this is a back-to-back.

Covers analyst Chris Faria put Under 6.5 in a parlay, citing strong defense from both teams. The page also says Markstrom has a .885 SV% and has allowed 3+ goals in three straight starts, and that the Over is 5-0-1 in Boston's last 6 games as a favorite.
